claims.claim: Accounts Payable tabs: Inbox, Matching, Payments, Disputes, Activity and Reports. Invoices move through states such as matched, approved, partially paid, paid, and disputed. Matching lines, recording payments and working disputes need the Finance AP or admin role.
Target: no aging unpaid invoices. Watch the Disputes tab and follow up with the vendor.

Troubleshooting: invoice shows disputed — someone opened a dispute; work it on the Disputes tab: resolve with credit issued, invoice voided, or invoice upheld. IVR Pending > 24 h — record the answer with Update Status.
Your daily loop includes responding to restock requests and tracking A/P status as the vendor (the card's pages are the vendor's own).
